independent_runtime_reexecution.note: The exact code blocker below is source-path complete and does not depend on a timing-sensitive or environment-sensitive runtime observation.

required_hostile_classes.evidence: Eligible temporal forms are CONDITION/DIRECTED_RELATION/RECURRENT_ACTIVITY only; EVENT is rejected.
K3 is outside eligible assertion kinds; TRANSITION and ORDERED_HISTORY are outside eligible temporal forms.
Resolver uses are checked as a subset of publication uses, publication uses as a subset of producer uses, with the generic non-event REVIEW/CONTEXT ceiling.
Mutable latest/default/* selectors are rejected and resolution remains exact-key only.

D05 accepts currentness_receipt_ref_or_null as an opaque ExactRef and, for CURRENT serving, checks only non-null presence. It never validates the referenced receipt schema/type/hash, exact resolution binding, authority/basis/effective-time binding, or CURRENT state. M5's accepted currentness seam requires all of those and explicitly rejects any state other than CURRENT. Therefore an exact ref to a STALE, REFRESH_REQUIRED, INVALID, unrelated, or resolution-mismatched receipt can satisfy D05's CURRENT gate.
CURRENT K4 is rejected when negative_or_closure_refs is empty. This result does not upgrade opaque closure refs into separately validated authoritative termination coverage.
Serving receipt fixes actor_state_effect=false and ingress effect to structural-context eligibility only.
Objective actor and objective position-context bindings are carried as optional exact refs and are not rejected merely for actor indexing.
Selection is checked against exact producer/publication refs and content-addressed serving identity is recomputed.
Resolved staged item currentness is copied into the serving receipt; no serving-time relabel from HISTORICAL to CURRENT is present.

primary_code_qualification.why_it_blocks: HQ/C06 require an exact CURRENT structural-currentness receipt for the M5-style ingress shape, while the D05 adapter proves only that some ExactRef is present. Exact identity of a reference is not proof of the referenced object's currentness state or binding.
